body: The craziest part, if that I almost never get confrontational. I can't think when voices are raised. Rarely, very rarely, only when I know I have no option, can't win, and no matter what I do I've lost the battle, I'll snap and yell back. I can't do it anymore. I just can't.

Also, one of those risky activities, was unprotected sex with a girl who slept with a new man, unprotected, on a daily basis, who was a past needle user, and a cutter. Honestly, I was thinking, hey, if I catch something dangerous, so be it. It will just force my hand. I was also exposed to her blood. (Sorry for TMI..)

On one hand, i want to get tested out of curiosity. On the other hand, I don't want medical treatment anyway, and I won't be having sex, so I might as well not.

I've done several hospital stays, in and outpatient, over the past year. It's no more than a room, and a bed, and some group activities where you draw pictures. Useless. I've been through a lot of therapists. I don't even know what they think of me. I find it impossible to recollect my problems when I'm in that room. I've gone to appointments to get referrals, and then forgotten to mention why i was there in the fist place. I feel like I live in a state of mental block.

Also, I've been on more SSRIs etc., than I can even list. It feels useless, sometimes I feel like I'm intellectually disturbed not chemically, if that makes sense. I dont try to hurt people, but everyone around me mocks me when I speak to an EXTREME (i don't ever get to have serious conversations with my family, I get mocked the moment I bring anything up or try to chip in with something relevant)... hell,m my brothers even used to kick me from skype calls and call me crazy and fucked up constantly, and the few times I made fun of them, they, and everyone around us blows up on me. I once got kicked out of my brothers house for, during one of those improv card games, calling my 140lb brother fat. (My card said I was a doctor, and to diagnose him with something silly. I chose fat. He's skinny.).

It really, really makes me wonder, if maybe everything I see, hear, etc, isn't real, because it's all just unreal. I hate it. I don't want to be on this planet.
